title: Measuring How System Prompt Complexity Affects Monitoring Accuracy

original_idea.body:
# Measuring How System Prompt Complexity Affects Monitoring Accuracy

**Problem:** Complex system prompts with many constraints may confuse monitoring classifiers about what is 'normal' vs. 'anomalous' for a given agent. The relationship between system prompt complexity and monitoring accuracy is unknown.

**Direction:** Test the same monitoring classifier on agents with simple vs. complex system prompts (varying number of constraints, length, internal contradictions). Measure detection accuracy for identical attack types under each prompt complexity level.

**Why it matters:** Real deployments use complex system prompts. If complexity degrades monitoring accuracy, this represents a systematic vulnerability in enterprise agent deployments.

**Relevant context:** System prompt complexity; agent deployment practice; monitoring accuracy.
